title: FXAA vs SMAA Anti-Aliasing Comparison with Scoring System
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (r152+) with EffectComposer that implements an advanced FXAA vs SMAA anti-aliasing comparison tool with a scoring/evaluation system.

SCENE SETUP:
- Split-screen viewport: left half shows FXAA pass, right half shows SMAA pass, separated by a visible vertical divider line (white, 2px)
- Scene contains deliberately aliasing-prone geometry: a rotating wireframe icosahedron (radius 3), a grid of thin diagonal lines (20 lines, 45-degree angle), and a high-contrast checkerboard plane (8x8, black/white)
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera, FOV 60, position (0, 5, 12), looking at origin
- Lighting: one DirectionalLight (white, intensity 1.0) at (5, 10, 5), one AmbientLight (0x404040)
- Background color: 0x1a1a2e

POST-PROCESSING:
- Left viewport: RenderPass + ShaderPass with FXAAShader, resolution uniforms set correctly
- Right viewport: RenderPass + SMAAPass (using SMAAImageLoader for search/area textures)
- Each side renders to its own WebGLRenderTarget at full resolution
- Final composite pass combines both halves onto screen

SCORING SYSTEM:
- Implement an edge-detection scoring algorithm that samples pixels along known edge boundaries
- Score is 0-100 for each method, measuring edge smoothness (fewer jagged steps = higher score)
- Scoring runs automatically every 2 seconds and updates displayed scores
- Track a history array of last 10 score pairs

USER INTERACTIONS:
- Key '1': Set FXAA quality to LOW (resolution scale 0.5x)
- Key '2': Set FXAA quality to MEDIUM (resolution scale 1.0x)
- Key '3': Set FXAA quality to HIGH (resolution scale 2.0x)
- Key 'S': Toggle SMAA quality between LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH (cycles)
- Key 'R': Reset rotation angle to 0 and clear score history
- Key 'P': Pause/resume the icosahedron rotation
- Key 'D': Toggle the divider line visibility
- Key 'U': Undo last quality change (restore previous FXAA and SMAA quality settings)
- Click on left half: temporarily disable FXAA (show raw render) for 3 seconds, then re-enable
- Click on right half: temporarily disable SMAA (show raw render) for 3 seconds, then re-enable
- DOM button 'Export Scores': downloads score history as JSON string to a textarea element

HUD/UI:
- Top-left: 'FXAA' label + current quality level + current score
- Top-right: 'SMAA' label + current quality level + current score
- Bottom-center: rotation angle in degrees (0-360), frame count
- DOM button with id='export-btn' for exporting scores
- DOM textarea with id='score-output' for displaying exported JSON
- DOM element with id='status-bar' showing current mode description

STATE MANAGEMENT (window.__3D_STATE__):
- fxaaEnabled: boolean
- smaaEnabled: boolean
- fxaaQuality: 'LOW'|'MEDIUM'|'HIGH'
- smaaQuality: 'LOW'|'MEDIUM'|'HIGH'
- fxaaScore: number (0-100)
- smaaScore: number (0-100)
- scoreHistory: array of {fxaa: number, smaa: number} objects (max 10)
- rotationAngle: number (degrees, 0-360)
- rotationPaused: boolean
- dividerVisible: boolean
- frameCount: number
- undoStack: array of {fxaaQuality: string, smaaQuality: string} objects
- lastAction: string describing last user action
- exportedData: string (JSON of score history when exported)

ANIMATION:
- Icosahedron rotates at 30 degrees/second around Y-axis when not paused
- Frame counter increments each frame
- Rotation angle wraps at 360 back to 0
- Scoring updates every 120 frames
physics_constraints: Rotation must be continuous and wrap at 360 degrees. Score values must be bounded 0-100 and never NaN. Score history must not exceed 10 entries (FIFO). Undo stack preserves exact previous quality states. Frame count must be monotonically increasing. FXAA resolution scale must correspond exactly to quality level (LOW=0.5, MEDIUM=1.0, HIGH=2.0).
